## Description

The model marine diatom (one of the first sequenced genomes): fusiform, 27–32 × 4–6 µm, almost without
silica in the fusiform morph; cultured at 20 °C (18–22 °C). Marine: not in the freshwater drops.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: not seeded in the default drops (inoculate it from the Catalogue).
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A fusiform outline with both tips tapered; inoculated from the catalogue.
